tagline.en: A video-to-audio model that generates a soundtrack to match a silent clip.
tagline.zh: 一个视频到音频模型，为无声片段生成配套的声音。

en: ThinkSound is a video-to-audio generation model: given a video clip, it synthesizes matching audio, turning a silent scene into one with sound. It comes from the FunAudioLLM project and uses a diffusion-based approach to audio generation.

In WorldFoundry it targets the video-to-audio and audio-generation routes — you feed it video and it produces an audio track. It runs from the ThinkSound diffusion checkpoint, staged in your local or Hugging Face cache.
zh: ThinkSound 是一个视频到音频生成模型：给它一段视频，它便合成与之匹配的音频，把无声画面变得有声。它来自 FunAudioLLM 项目，采用基于扩散的音频生成方法。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它面向视频到音频与音频生成路径——你输入视频，它产出一条音轨。它从 ThinkSound 扩散 checkpoint 运行，checkpoint 放在你的本地或 Hugging Face 缓存中。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to generate an audio track for a silent video clip — adding sound that follows what happens on screen.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想为一段无声视频生成音轨时使用——添加与画面内容相呼应的声音。

notFor.en: It is an audio generator, not a video model — it produces sound for video you already have. It requires the ThinkSound diffusion checkpoint to be available in your cache before it can run.
notFor.zh: 它是音频生成器，而非视频模型——它为你已有的视频生成声音。运行前需要 ThinkSound 扩散 checkpoint 已在你的缓存中就绪。
